# Dashild

> Dashild is an admin layer for Next.js and Prisma: one resource file per model,
> server-enforced policies, and a shadcn UI you own.

Install a new app:

```bash
pnpm create dashild@latest my-app
```

Add the agent skill to an existing project:

```bash
pnpm dashild skill install
```

Docs: https://dashild.vercel.app
Full text for LLMs: https://dashild.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Start

- [Installation](https://dashild.vercel.app/getting-started/installation/): create an app or add the panel to an existing Next.js project.
- [Upgrading](https://dashild.vercel.app/getting-started/upgrading/): `dashild upgrade`, version markers, what can break.
- [AI assistant](https://dashild.vercel.app/getting-started/ai/): install the skill and verify generated code.

## Guides

- [Resources](https://dashild.vercel.app/guides/resources/): tables, forms, filters, relations, custom cells.
- [Policies and security](https://dashild.vercel.app/guides/policies/): scope, roles, fail-closed, tenant isolation.
- [Multi-tenancy](https://dashild.vercel.app/guides/multi-tenancy/): organizations, switcher, scoped creates.
- [Authentication](https://dashild.vercel.app/guides/authentication/): Better Auth, sessions, email.
- [Customization](https://dashild.vercel.app/guides/customization/): cells, fields, icons, eject.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://dashild.vercel.app/reference/cli/): init, make:resource, make:action, doctor, upgrade, ui:add, skill install, eject.
- [Templates](https://dashild.vercel.app/reference/templates/): basic, blog, demo, saas, local and GitHub starters.
- [Server API](https://dashild.vercel.app/reference/server-api/): runtime, policies, scopes, query and write helpers.

## Examples

- [Vet clinic (multi-tenant)](https://dashild.vercel.app/examples/vet-clinic/): full tutorial with roles, relations, actions and filters.
- [Examples overview](https://dashild.vercel.app/examples/): runnable apps in the repository.
